name: Butter Pecan
description: Whiskey Hazelnut’s cousin! Pecan pieces are roasted with butter and salt, and added to our ice cream base with organic vanilla. Comfort in a scoop!

name: Fresh Lemon
description: “One of the favourites in the warmer months, it’s a refreshing and light flavour. We reduce down lemon juice and lemon zest from our friends at Chasers Juice and then add some lemon oil to really boost the flavour. This is simply mixed in with our ice cream base for an almost yoghurt- like flavour!”

name: London Fog
description: Made with Assam and Darjeeling black tea, bergamot and vanilla, this ice cream flavour is based on the popular drink which was invented in Vancouver!

name: Strawberry
description: Local strawberries from Mandair Farms are picked at the peak of the season and frozen to preserve their vibrant fruitiness to enjoy in winter. We add a touch of white balsamic to enhance and balance the natural sweetness of the strawberries. A must try for fans of strawberry ice cream!

name: Vegan Blueberries & Cream
description: The perfect mix of light vanilla and bright berry flavours, this new flavour is like a bowl of fresh blueberries topped with whipped cream! Our vanilla oat-coconut base is brightened with a splash of lemon juice and swirled with house-made blueberry compote from all Canadian berries.

name: Vegan Toasted Coconut
description: The vegan version of our beloved toasted coconut ice cream. Desiccated coconut is toasted in house, supplying a depth of nutty flavour. Coconut extract is added to pack in those wonderful tropical tasting notes. Creamy coconut bliss!

name: Cannoli
description: The classic Italian pastry made into a delectable ice cream! Ricotta and cream cheese are combined in the base to achieve the right cheesy flavour, with orange zest adding a pop of brightness to balance. Mini chocolate chips and pieces of crunchy (gluten free!) cannoli shell are sprinkled throughout for lovely bites of texture.

name: Chocolate
description: Smooth, creamy, and oh-so-chocolatey! This ice cream is a lovely balance between our Milk Chocolate and Serious Chocolate flavours, and is sure to satisfy any chocolate-lover.

name: Cookies + Cream
description: Organic Chocolate Vanilla Cream Sandwich Cookies, featuring a darker chocolate flavour profile with a crisp cookie crunch. It’s all about the cookies, like a spoonful of childhood!

name: Lemon Tart
description: This flavour originated as a sundae, but it was so scrumptious that we had to make it into an ice cream! Buttery, flaky pie crust pieces and a tangy lemon curd swirl in vanilla ice cream make for a balance of sweet, tart, creamy, and crispy in each bite.

name: Matcha Green Tea
description: Our matcha green tea powder is supplied by Aiya and grown in Nishio, a historic tea cultivation region in Japan, from a family owned and operated farm for the last 125 years. It’s a shade-grown matcha, giving it light colour and caramel notes. Aiya are dedicated to giving back to the world through helping with the reforestation of mangrove and mahogany forests in Southeast Asia. We simply blend the matcha powder straight into our ice cream base!

name: Mint Chip
description: The classic mint chocolate ice cream made with lots of house made dark chocolate chips! Like peppermint patty but better. No artificial food colouring is added so it’s white, not green. Fresh and minty, with the added crunch from the dark chocolate flakes.

name: Raspberry
description: Locally sourced raspberries harvested in the peak of summer from our friends at family-run Mandair Farms bring this flavour to life. Its bright, tart and fresh – perfect for summer days.

name: Salted Caramel
description: A classic for good reason. We’ve been making this one since day one and it remains a favourite still. Deeply caramelized sugar mixed with cream and salt from Vancouver Island Sea Salt Co. Its rich, creamly and buttery and the perfect balance of salty and sweet.

name: Tahitian Vanilla
description: This flavour has been a core since day one. Our pure vanilla extract is sourced from premium slow-grown, sun-cured vanilla beans of the “Tahitian” variety. The flavour from the beans is cold-extracted to preserve its complex bouquet. These vanilla beans are brighter and more floral than the rounder, woodsier Madagascar variety.

name: Vegan Cookies + Cream
description: A vegan twist on a childhood favourite that is brimming with chunks of cookies in a creamy vanilla base. Fun fact, we make this flavour with the exact same organic chocolate sandwich cookies we use in our dairy cookies and cream!

name: Vegan Key Lime Pie
description: Our take on key lime pie in vegan ice cream form! A tart lime-coconut ice cream base with a house-made graham crumble. The sweet crumble offsets the tartness of the base, creating a nicely balanced bite with a scrumptious texture!

name: Vegan Mango
description: We blend mango puree into our classic vegan base, resulting in a beautifully vibrant and fruity treat! Mango puree is sourced from Ponthier.

name: Vegan Raspberry
description: One of our original vegan flavours. Local raspberries from Mandair Farms pureed and blended into our signature vegan coconut base – it’s bright, tart, refreshing and looks as good as it tastes.

name: Whiskey Hazelnut
description: An Earnest Ice Cream original, made from day one and remains a favourite and top-seller. Roasted, salted BC hazelnuts in Whiskey ice cream base. A smooth, boozy flavour with a buttery crunch.

name: Classic Sammie
description: Our take on a classic ice cream sandwich. Tahitian vanilla ice cream is sandwiched between chocolate cake and finished with a thin layer of fudge sauce. This flavour never goes out of style!

name: Sour Cherry Goat Cheese
description: This complex flavour is tart and rich – with an elevated fro-yo tanginess. Highlighting Okanagan cherries (sourced through Pacific Coast Fruit) and goat cheese from Hewitt’s, a Canadian farmer-owned company.

name: Sour Cherry Goat Cheese Sammie
description: Since we missed it as a seasonal, this cult classic is back as a sammie, but with a twist! Goat cheese ice cream is swirled with sour cherry compote to create a wonderfully cheesy and fruity flavour profile. Topped with a tart cherry jam that has a hint of almond extract added to boost that cherry flavour, plus a layer of goat cheese-vanilla cake crumble to complete this cheesy sammie. It’s the perfect bright treat for these hot summer days!

name: Vegan Cookie Butter Sammie
description: House-made speculoos cookies are combined in a variety of ways into this delectable ice cream! Rich cookie butter is swirled throughout a lightly spiced base and topped with a speculoos cookie crumble for a lovely bite of added texture.
